findings.summary: setup() has a concrete top-of-method guard redirecting null / non-2FA / already-confirmed users to dashboard before any secret is read; EnsureTwoFactor also redirects confirmed admins hitting two-factor.setup/confirm to dashboard.

mode pinned as required|in:totp,recovery with conditional Rule::when validation on single code field (TOTP ^\d{6}$; recovery XXXX-XXXX optional hyphen); 'deteksi dari field terisi' alternative removed.

DecryptException handled at all three secret-read sites with correct per-site response (verifyChallenge pre-login -> redirect login; setup/confirmSetup post-login -> reset + re-enroll); error table has two distinct rows.
two-factor.recovery-codes.regenerate route now carries ->middleware('throttle:two-factor'), same limiter as challenge/confirm.

integerOnly confirmed as a valid InputOtp prop by reading node_modules/primevue/inputotp/index.d.ts directly; inputmode numeric and InputText fallback specified; server-side ^\d{6}$ is the real guard.
two_factor_recovery_codes mutator uses empty($value) ? null : ... so an emptied array normalizes to NULL, consistent with the reset path.
